notes: Modified cash basis village audit (governmental modified cash, business-type accrual), as FY2023. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p6-7): roll-forward on fund balances 1,513,590 + 678,023 - 780,073 + transfers in (out) net 87,406 - unrealized loss on investments 81,515 (other financing) = 1,417,431. transfers_in is the printed net Total column 'Transfers in (out)' 87,406 (General +113,390, Street +28,205, Sinking -48,923, Library Memorial -5,266). Ending cash = Total Governmental Funds 'Cash and cash equivalents' 964,755 (p5); county treasurer cash 6,491 not included; CDs 13,627 + investments 432,558 in ending_investments. No prior-year cash printed, so beginning_cash null. Business-type from the proprietary statement (p9), matching the government-wide accrual column (expenses 1,389,269 = operating 1,377,500 + interest 11,769, p2): 2,924,038 + 1,502,496 - 1,389,269 - 87,406 = 2,949,859. Proprietary cash flows (p10-11) printed but left null as in FY2023/FY2024. Balance sheet = Statement of Net Position (governmental column includes capital assets and debt). Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining statement (p19-20; more detailed than the General Fund budget schedule p12, which is not recorded to avoid double counting; police contract 48,099 in the General column is Public safety-Police per p12; cemetery is under Public works per p12; Fire/EMS debt payments are in the statement's principal/interest lines); Street, Sinking, Library Memorial and CDBG budget schedules (p13-16); nonmajor combining columns (p17-18). Zero-actual budget lines (Street charges for services, other) not recorded. No utility budget schedules in the trim, so no business-type detail. Read pages 1-20 of 20
